Aimed Shot.name: Aimed Shot
Aimed Shot.text: This unit can fire at any enemy unit within range and line of sight, even if it is not the closest enemy unit.

Artillery.name: Artillery
Artillery.text: This unit consists of an artillery piece and crew. Such units may not move and shoot in the same activation, though they may manoeuvre and shoot.

Brace.name: Brace
Brace.text: If a unit with the Charge attribute moves into combat with the front facing of this unit, the moving unit loses one level of Charge.

Champion.name: Champion
Champion.text: If this unit engages in melee combat, the player rolls the Champion Die as one of their Combat Dice.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.text: This unit receives –1 to its Target Number for each level (X) of Charge for any combat that occurs during the unit’s activation.

Child of Stone.name: Child of Stone
Child of Stone.text: This figure is immune to the Horrific and Stone Gaze attributes. Additionally, it gains +2 Defence against Fire Breath attacks.

Command.name: Command
Command.text: A unit containing a figure with the Command attribute allows its player to roll 3 dice for activation rolls and morale tests – for that unit and any other unit within 6”. Additionally, if the unit containing the figure with Command passes its activation roll, the player can attempt to activate X additional units at the same time.

Courage.name: Courage
Courage.text: This unit adds its level (X) to all morale test rolls.

Crew.name: Crew
Crew.text: This is the number of individual crew included with an artillery piece in a unit with the Artillery attribute.

Discorporate.name: Discorporate
Discorporate.text: If this unit passes its activation roll, the unit may teleport to any other point on the table within 12”, instead of taking any other actions during its activation. This teleport action may not result in the unit being closer than 2” to any enemy unit.The unit may be placed facing any direction at the end of the teleport action.

Eldest.name: Eldest
Eldest.text: Figures with this trait gain +2 Defence against any attack generated by a spell. Additionally, treat all non-elf units in the same army as though they had the Expected to Run attribute.

Enormous.name: Enormous
Enormous.text: This figure is truly massive compared to a human or an orc. Enormous figures are almost always units-of-one. This trait affects the unit’s line of sight, as well as how many Combat Dice artillery units roll when firing against it.

Expected to Run.name: Expected to Run
Expected to Run.text: Most units in the army expect these figures to run away. If this unit breaks, only other units with the Expected to Run attribute are subject to the Cascading Panic rule.

Fire Breath.name: Fire Breath
Fire Breath.text: Once per activation, this figure may use an action to make a Fire Breath shooting attack. The controlling player rolls 5 Combat Dice, including the Champion Die. This attack uses the figure’s normal Shoot stat. The target may use Shielding against this attack. The target must make a morale test after this attack, even if they do not suffer casualties, unless they would not normally have to make a morale test even if they did suffer casualties.

Flying.name: Flying
Flying.text: This figure ignores all movement penalties for terrain. It can even move over impassable terrain and other units provided it can complete its movement without being in contact with them (unless of course, they are moving into combat).

Haste.name: Haste
Haste.text: If this figure, or unit, makes a manoeuvre as a simple action, it may immediately afterward make a free half move. This move cannot be a move into combat but otherwise follows all the normal rules for movement.

Horrific.name: Horrific
Horrific.text: If an enemy unit must make a morale test after a round of combat with this unit, its controlling player rolls one die less than usual for that test (to a minimum of 1).

Indirect Fire.name: Indirect Fire
Indirect Fire.text: This figure may make a shooting attack at a unit to which it cannot draw line of sight, provided at least one other friendly unit can draw line of sight to the target. A unit suffers a +1 penalty to its Target Number for all shooting attacks when using this ability. Further, units containing figures with Indirect Fire do not have to fire at the closest unit and can shoot over all units between it and the target.

Large.name: Large
Large.text: This figure is significantly larger than any figures from the core races. Its size affects its line of sight as well as how many Combat Dice artillery receive when firing at it.

Legendary Hero.name: Legendary Hero
Legendary Hero.text: This figure possesses one or more heroic traits and can gain experience points. See Appendix D, page 207.

Limited Manoeuvres.name: Limited Manoeuvres
Limited Manoeuvres.text: This figure may not perform pivot or about-face manoeuvres. Furthermore, when performing a wheel manoeuvre, this unit may not wheel more than 90 degrees in a single action.

Limited Movement.name: Limited Movement
Limited Movement.text: This figure may not move over any obstacles, even climbable ones. Furthermore, any time this unit moves or manoeuvres into contact with rough ground, it must make an immediate activation roll with a –3 modifier. If the unit fails this roll, its activation ends immediately, and it suffers 1 hit per figure in the unit. Otherwise, it may continue its activation as usual. If the unit begins its activation in – or in contact with – rough ground, it makes its activation roll as usual, with no modifier, and does not have to roll again for that specific area of rough ground unless it completely exits and re-enters it.

Magic Items.name: Magic Items
Magic Items.text: This figure can carry magic items.

Monster.name: Monster
Monster.text: Monsters are always units-of-one. They never receive any benefits from figures with Command, and they cannot be activated along with other units because of Command. Monsters always roll the Champion Die as one of their combat dice in melee combat.

Nimble.name: Nimble
Nimble.text: This figure never suffers movement penalties for moving through rough ground.

Poisonous Breath.name: Poisonous Breath
Poisonous Breath.text: Once per activation, a unit containing a figure with this ability may spend an action to breathe poison on any unit within 12” to which it has line of sight. The target unit’s player must immediately roll 5 dice and take 1 hit for each result lower than the attacking unit’s Activation stat. The target unit also receives –1 Fight for the rest of the turn. Casualties caused by this attack do not trigger morale tests.

Regenerate.name: Regenerate
Regenerate.text: Whenever this figure is activated, it gains back Health equal to its regeneration level (X). This ability can never take the figure above its starting Health. If this figure is part of a unit, then the unit gains back Health equal to (X), not every figure.

Shadowform.name: Shadowform
Shadowform.text: This figure exists only partially on this plane of existence; thus, it is impossible to kill it with normal weapons. Only magic weapons and fire can harm it. Thankfully, it is just common enough that most units know what to do when they encounter one. This figure takes the usual damage from any attack generated by a spell or otherwise defined as magical or firebased, and from any figure wielding a magic weapon. If a unit in combat with this figure contains a figure with a magic weapon, it may elect to have that figure fight alone. If so, use only that figure’s stats to determine the Target Number and Combat Dice. However, continue to use the unit’s usual Defence stat to determine the Target Number of the figure with the Shadowform attribute. If the unit does not contain figures with magic weapons (or the player chooses not to use them in the fight), the combat proceeds as normal, albeit with the unit rolling a maximum of 2 Combat Dice (this may include the Champion Die), to represent attacking with lit torches. Use the same rules for shooting attacks against this figure, reducing the unit to a maximum of 2 Combat Dice.

Shielding.name: Shielding
Shielding.text: During combat, a unit containing figures with Shielding may choose to sacrifice one Combat Die for each level of Shielding it possesses (X), thus forcing the enemy unit to discard an equal number of Combat Dice. Shielding deductions are made after all other factors determining Combat Dice are considered, and they may never lower a unit’s Combat Dice below 1. Shielding may only be used by a unit that is not currently active – in other words, the unit initiating the combat cannot use Shielding. Units may not use Shielding during an attack to the unit’s flank or rear. Additionally, if this unit is the target of a shooting attack to any facing accept its rear, it may use Shielding to reduce the number of Combat Dice the attacking unit can roll against it by 1 for each level of Shielding it possesses. Again, this cannot reduce the number of Combat Dice below 1. Units cannot use Shielding against shooting attacks from artillery. A unit never has to discard its Champion Die due to Shielding.

Shoot Over.name: Shoot Over
Shoot Over.text: When making a shooting attack or casting a spell, this figure can draw line of sight through one unit in the same army, provided at least one model in that unit is within 3” and the unit contains no Large or Enormous models.

Spellcaster.name: Spellcaster
Spellcaster.text: This figure knows a number of spells equal to its spellcaster level (X) +2. Players must choose these spells before the start of each game. Whenever a spellcaster attempts to cast a spell, the player rolls dice equal to the spellcaster’s level (X).

Spellcaster Control.name: Spellcaster Control
Spellcaster Control.text: This figure may only join an army that also contains a figure with the Spellcaster attribute that is not also a Monster. Further, if at any point this army no longer has a spellcaster on the table that isn’t also a Monster, immediately remove all figures in this army with this attribute and count them as casualties.

Stone Gaze.name: Stone Gaze
Stone Gaze.text: Whenever this figure is activated, even if it fails its activation roll, choose an enemy unit within 12” and line of sight. That unit must roll one die. If the result is lower than the unit’s Activation stat, it takes 1 hit. This ability is automatic and does not take an action to use. This hit can cause a morale test.

Uncaring.name: Uncaring
Uncaring.text: This figure does not have the same sense of self-preservation as most creatures. Whenever an Uncaring unit is involved in melee combat and must make a morale test, it automatically passes; however, it takes additional damage equal to one hit for each full –2 modifier to the morale test. For example, if a unit of 20 skeletons takes 4 casualties, it must make a morale test with a –3 modifier (–4 for casualties, +1 for having over 2 full ranks). It passes this morale test automatically, but it takes 1 additional hit. If the unit suffers casualties from sources other than melee attacks, it automatically passes its morale test, as usual, but it does not suffer additional damage. A unit that contains figures with the Uncaring attribute may never possess any levels of Shielding. Any spells or other special effects that give the unit Shielding have no effect. A unit that contains figures with the special ability Uncaring never suffers any of the effects from Death of an Officer.

Undead.name: Undead
Undead.text: This figure automatically passes all morale tests. Furthermore, it is immune to the effects of Poison Breath and Stone Gaze. Because an undead figure feels no pain, it is hard to stop with missile weapons. Whenever an Undead unit suffers an attack from bows, determine the number of hits, then halve that number (rounding up). For example, if a unit of elf archers fires on a unit of 20 skeletons and it takes 3 hits, reduce that number to 2 hits (3/2 = 1.5, rounded up to 2).

Unreliable.name: Unreliable
Unreliable.text: This figure suffers –1 to all Morale Tests. This figure can never benefit from any aspect of the Command attribute, so it never gains extra dice for Activation, nor can it attempt to activate with a unit with the Command attribute. If this figure ever rolls a natural ‘1’ on all its activation dice when attempting to activate (which might just be 1), then not only does it fail to activate, but it also switches sides. This figure takes no action this turn. Next turn, it may be activated by the opposing player. It stays with this army either until it again rolls all ‘1’s and thus switches back or until the end of the game. If this figure is fighting on the other side at the end of a battle, consider it a casualty for determining victory conditions.

Unthinking.name: Unthinking
Unthinking.text: This figure rolls only 1 die for activation rolls. If the figure is within range of a unit that contains a figure with the Command attribute, increase this to 2 dice. A unit that contains a figure with the Unthinking attribute may never roll more than 2 dice for activation rolls.

Waterwalk.name: Waterwalk
Waterwalk.text: This figure does not suffer any movement penalties for moving through water. Nor does it ever suffer any hits or damage from drowning.

Wild Charge.name: Wild Charge
Wild Charge.text: When this figure is active and engaged in combat, it may use Wild Charge to re-roll any one Combat Die. The controlling player may make this decision after rolling, and may choose which die to re-roll, including the Champion Die. If a player decides to use this ability, their opponent may also re-roll one Combat Die of their choosing.

A.name: Activation
A.text: The figure's training and morale. This stat is used whenever you wish to activate the figure or when the figure must make a morale test.

M.name: Move
M.text: The figure's speed in battle situations.

F.name: Fight
F.text: The figure's skill or natural talent in hand-to-hand combat.

S.name: Shoot
S.text: The figure's skill or natural talent with missile weapons, such as bows and slings.

D.name: Defence
D.text: The figure's natural toughness and/or armour.

CD.name: Combat Dice
CD.text: The number of dice you roll for this figure in a melee combat or when making a shooting attack.

H.name: Health
H.text: The amount of damage a figure can sustain before it must be removed from the table as a casualty. This number is 1 for most human-sized creatures.

pts.name: Points
pts.text: The figure's overall value in an army. This number reflects the cost when selecting this figure for your army and the worth of the figure when determining battle outcomes according to casualties/point values.

spells.name: Courage
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. This unit gains the special ability Courage (1). If the unit already has this special ability, increase the level by one – Courage (1) becomes Courage (2), Courage (2) becomes Courage (3), etc.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on a single figure within 18”. The figure receives +1 Combat Die (limited to the normal maximum of 5).

spells.name: Dispel
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit within 24”. All ongoing effects from all spells cast on the target unit or figure are cancelled. This spell has no effect on spells that have a one-off effect, such as Heal.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit within 18”. Immediately make a Shoot 4, 3 Combat Dice shooting attack against that unit.

spells.name: Fleetfeet
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit.All figures in that unit receive +2 to their Move stat for the remainder of the game.

spells.name: Heal
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on a single figure within 18” (as long as the unit containing the figure is in line of sight). That figure regains 1 Health (to their maximum Health). A figure may not have Heal cast on it more than once per game.

spells.name: Looking Glass
spells.text: Place a marker anywhere within the spellcaster’s line of sight. For the remainder of the game, the spellcaster who cast this spell may draw line of sight from the marker instead of their figure.

spells.name: Mystic Shield
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit.All figures in that unit receive the Shielding (1) attribute. This spell may not be cast on a unit that already has Shielding.

spells.name: Shift
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. That unit may immediately perform one manoeuvre, subject to the usual rules for manoeuvres.

spells.name: Smoke
spells.text: Place a line of smoke up to 10” long, 1” thick, and 2” high on the table.The entire line must be within the spellcaster’s line of sight. This smoke blocks line of sight. At the end of each turn, roll one die. If the result is 9 or 10, remove the smoke.

spells.name: Dragon Bane
spells.text: You may cast this spell on any unit. For the rest of the turn, any damage this unit deals in combat to a unit with the special ability Enormous is doubled.

spells.name: Earthbound
spells.text: You may cast this spell against any unit that possesses the Flying attribute. This unit now has -1 Activation for the rest of the game.Additionally, on any turn in which the unit fails its activation roll, it may not use the Flying attribute.

spells.name: Inspiration
spells.text: You may cast this spell on any unit that contains a temporary officer. The temporary officer is promoted to a full officer, and the unit no longer suffers any penalties for Death of an Officer. They may, however, suffer Death of an Officer again in the same game.

spells.name: Sphere Of Protection
spells.text: You may cast this spell on any unit. For the rest of the game, this unit is completely immune to the effects of Fire Breath, Poisonous Breath, or Stone Gaze.

spells.name: Tanglefeet
spells.text: You may cast this spell on any unit, provided that unit does not possess any of the following attributes: Large, Enormous, Flying, or Nimble. The unit is ensnared in a thick bramble that suddenly grows under its feet. It must spend one action to untangle itself. Until it does so, it may not take any Move or Manoeuvre actions.

spells.name: Brace
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. That unit gains the Brace attribute.

spells.name: Explosive Ammunition
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly artillery unit. The next time that unit makes a shooting attack, it receives +1 to its Shoot stat and +1 Combat Dice (to a max of 5).

spells.name: Fortress
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. This unit has Shielding (3) until the next time it moves. This shield does apply to artillery shooting attacks, unlike normal.

spells.name: Gathering Of Crows
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. That unit has Shielding (2) whenever it is the target of a shooting attack.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. Immediately make a Shoot 6, Combat Dice 1 shooting attack against that unit using the Champion Die.

spells.name: Resolute
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit that is Disordered. That unit is no longer Disordered.

spells.name: Stoneheart
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit.All figures in that unit receive +1 Defence.

spells.name: Sunder
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. That unit loses one level of Shielding. (For example, a unit with Shielding (2) now has Shielding (1), and a unit with Shielding (1) loses their Shielding ability altogether.)

spells.name: Confound
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. That unit’s controlling player must immediately roll 1 die. If the result is lower than the unit’s Activation stat, it receives no actions the next time it makes an activation roll.

spells.name: Earthlines
spells.text: Spellcasters may only cast this spell on themselves. For the remainder of the game, the spellcaster may roll one extra die when casting a spell, to a maximum of 5. (For example, a Spellcaster (3) would roll 4 dice.) FOOL’S GOLD (CN8) The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. That unit must make an immediate activation roll. If it fails, the spellcaster may cause the unit to perform one manoeuvre, subject to the usual rules for manoeuvres.

spells.name: Glamour
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. Immediately move that unit anywhere on the table so that at least one figure in the unit is still within the spellcaster’s line of sight. The unit may be placed facing any direction. The next time this unit activates, it may only take a simple action, even if it passes its activation roll.

spells.name: Pathfinder
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. All figures in that unit gain the Nimble attribute. The spellcaster may not cast this spell on a unit that already has the Nimble attribute.

spells.name: Phase
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. The next time that unit activates, it may ignore any movement penalties for any type of terrain, including moving through impassable terrain (so long as the unit does not end its activation inside a terrain piece).

spells.name: Trueflight
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit.All figures in that unit receive +1 to their Shoot stat.

spells.name: Truesight
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. All figures in the unit gain the Shoot Over attribute.

spells.name: Battlerage
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. The officer in that unit gains the Champion attribute. This spell has no effect on units in which a character already has the Champion attribute.

spells.name: Fury
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on a friendly unit. All figures in that unit receive the Wild Charge attribute. This spell has no effect on units in which the figures already have the Wild Charge attribute.

spells.name: Horrify
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. That unit gains the Horrific attribute.

spells.name: Immolate
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit within 4” of an enemy unit. Remove one figure as a casualty from the friendly unit (you do not need to make a morale test because of this casualty). Make an immediate Shoot 4, Combat Dice 4, shooting attack against one enemy unit within 4” of the unit that suffered the casualty.

spells.name: Poison Cloud
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. The target unit’s player must immediately roll 5 dice and take 1 hit for each result lower than the unit’s Activation stat.The target unit also receives –1 to its Fight stat for the rest of the turn. Casualties caused by this attack do not trigger morale tests.

spells.name: Rain Of Knives
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. Immediately make a Shoot 0, Combat Dice 5, shooting attack against that unit.

spells.name: Fear
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit that is not currently Disordered. That unit must make an immediate morale test.

spells.name: Weakness
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit.That unit suffers –1 to their Fight stat.

spells.name: Afflict
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any enemy unit. All figures in that unit suffer –1 to their Shoot stat.

spells.name: Bells Of Doom
spells.text: For the rest of the turn, every unit on the table rolls one less die for their activation roll.

spells.name: Blade Mastery
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit.All figures in that unit receive +1 to their Fight stat.

spells.name: Lifebane
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit.That unit takes 1 hit. If this causes the unit to suffer a casualty, it does not have to make a morale test.

spells.name: Mud
spells.text: The spellcaster’s controlling player may place an area of mud up to 6” long and 2” wide anywhere that is completely within line of sight of the caster but is not closer than 1” to any unit. This mud lasts until the end of the game unless dispelled. This mud counts as rough ground.

spells.name: Seize The Initiative
spells.text: While the spellcaster who cast this spell remains on the table, their army may roll 4 dice to determine initiative, instead of the usual 2 (choose which 2 dice count for determining Strange and Catastrophic Events before rolling).

spells.name: Sunblind
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any unit. That unit may not make a shooting attack during its next activation.

spells.name: Stolen March
spells.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell on any friendly unit. That unit may immediately make one Move action (using its full Move stat).The unit may not move into combat with this action.

spells.name: Bone Shards
spells.text: The necromancer makes an immediate Shoot 2, Combat Dice 2 shooting attack against the target unit.

spells.name: Death Vision
spells.text: The target unit must make an immediate morale test.

spells.name: Necrotic Touch
spells.text: The caster selects one friendly unit within line of sight.This unit immediately suffers 1 hit and must make a morale test as though it suffered this damage in melee combat. The necromancer may then select one friendly figure (including themselves) whose unit is within line of sight.This figure regains up to 1 Health.This may neither take a figure above its starting Health, nor bring back a figure that was reduced to 0 Health. A figure that takes damage from a Necrotic Touch spell cannot use Regeneration to heal this damage.

spells.name: Poison Blades
spells.text: The next time the target unit causes 2 or more hits in melee combat, it delivers one additional hit. After causing this additional hit, the spell’s effects end (though a necromancer may cast it again on the same unit). You cannot inflict this additional hit against an opposing unit if a majority of the figures in that unit have the special ability Undead.

spells.name: Reanimate
spells.text: This spell may be cast on a unit composed primarily of skeletal soldiers, skeletal spearman, or skeletal archers. The unit may immediately replace one figure that was killed during the game. For each ‘10’ rolled on the Casting Dice, replace one additional fallen skeleton to a maximum of three. You may not bring a character figure back with this spell. You may cast this spell on the same unit multiple times; each time, it gains another figure back. You may not use this spell to increase the number of figures in the unit beyond that which it contained at the start of the game.

spells.name: Revive
spells.text: This spell can be cast on a unit composed primarily of revenant warriors, revenant linebreakers, or revenant cavalry. The unit may immediately replace one figure that was killed during the game. You may not bring a character figure back with this spell. You may cast this spell on the same unit multiple times; each time, it gains another figure back. You may not use this spell to increase the number of figures in the unit beyond what it contained at the start of the game.

spells.name: Summon Barrow Worm
spells.text: Mark any point on the table that is within line of sight but is not directly on top of a unit (the point may be directly adjacent to a unit). At the end of the current turn, the controlling player rolls two dice. Move the marker a number of inches equal to the result on the higher of the two dice in a random direction. If this causes the marker to move off the table, it is lost, and the spell has no effect. If this causes the marker to land on top of a unit, move it to the closest point at which is 1” away from the unit. After moving the marker, replace it with a barrow worm. Treat this barrow worm as a unit in the spellcaster’s army. However, if the barrow worm ever rolls a 2 or less for its activation on its highest die, it burrows into the ground and is removed from the game. This also happens if the spellcaster who cast the spell is removed from the table for any reason. The caster may not use this spell again if there is a summoned barrow worm on the table. Do not take the barrow worm into consideration when determining victory conditions in a scenario.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Adamant
magicItems.text: Roll a die for each point of damage taken by a figure wearing this armour. If the result is 9 or higher, ignore that point of damage.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Starsilver
magicItems.text: Roll a die for each point of damage taken by a figure wearing this armour. If the result is 7 or higher, ignore that point of damage.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Courage
magicItems.text: All figures in a unit in which a figure carries this banner gain the special ability Courage (1). If they already have Courage, increase their Courage level by one. For example, a unit with Courage (1) now has Courage (2).

magicItems.name: Banner Of Glory
magicItems.text: Once per game, if a figure carrying this banner is part of a unit that fails a morale test, the player may choose to reroll that test.

magicItems.name: Boots Of Striding
magicItems.text: A figure that wears these boots gains the Nimble attribute.

magicItems.name: Crown Of Regeneration
magicItems.text: A figure that wears this crown gains the special ability Regeneration (1). This is not cumulative with other sources of Regeneration. Figures with the Undead attribute cannot use this item.

magicItems.name: Cloak Of Discorporation
magicItems.text: A figure that wears this cloak gains the Discorporate attribute.

magicItems.name: Golden String Bow
magicItems.text: If a figure with the Champion attribute carries this bow, its player may roll the Champion Die any time the figure, or the figure’s unit, makes a shooting attack.This is an exception to the normal Shooting attack procedure where no Champion Die is rolled.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Shielding
magicItems.text: A figure that wears this ring gains the special ability Shielding (1). If the figure already has Shielding, increase their Shielding level by one, to a maximum of Shielding (3). For example, a figure with Shielding (1) now has Shielding (2). This ring only affects attacks directed at the figure itself, not at the figure’s unit.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Spellcasting
magicItems.text: If a figure with the Spellcaster attribute wears this ring, it begins the game knowing one more spell than usual. For example, a figure with Spellcaster (1) knows 4 spells instead of 3.

magicItems.name: Sceptre Of Command
magicItems.text: If a figure with the Command attribute carries this sceptre, it may attempt to activate other units up to 9” away instead of the usual 6”.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Starsilver
magicItems.text: If a figure with the Champion attribute carries this hand weapon, add +1 to the Champion Die roll result. If the Champion Die result is a 9, treat the result as a 10 for the purposes of calculating hits, but not for the purposes of striking a character.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Flames
magicItems.text: If a figure with the Champion attribute carries this hand weapon, its player may re-roll any results of 1 on the Champion Die when the figure is in combat. The Champion Die may only be rerolled once, so you cannot reroll the Champion Die for both Wild Charge and the Sword of Flames.
